visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a circular, golden-brown fried meat pie being gently pulled apart by fingers to reveal a steaming interior. A distinct red circular stamp is visible on the crispy dough surface. Inside, juicy minced meat and bright green chopped onions are nestled within a thin, flaky dough layer. (2) The scene transitions to an outdoor street-side food stall where a woman in a red polo shirt and a white apron is rolling out fresh dough on a stainless steel work table. Beside her, a large industrial flat-top griddle is filled with rows of round pies and folded pockets frying in shimmering oil. An older man wearing a plaid apron and a grey headband stands by the griddle, managing the cooking process. (3) The camera shows a wider shot of the stall, revealing it is built onto the back of a small truck. Customers wearing motorcycle helmets stand nearby, waiting for their orders. Red plastic stools are positioned on the sidewalk. (4) Detailed close-up shots follow, showcasing different menu items being held up against the stall background, including a beef pie with a red dot, a pork pie without a dot, and a leek pocket filled with green chives and vermicelli. A scallion pancake cut into triangles is also seen inside a white and blue branded paper bag.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 有些味道不需要招牌. (2) [Subtitle]: 也能靠著現桿現煎的實力. (3) [Subtitle]: 在路邊賣了很多年. (4) [Subtitle]: 高雄這家無名餐車. (5) [Subtitle]: 是不少在地人. (6) [Subtitle]: 一直都在吃的老味道. (7) [Subtitle]: 我們很喜歡剛煎好的牛肉餡餅. (8) [Subtitle]: 外皮帶點微酥的Q勁. (9) [Subtitle]: 肉餡很紮實. (10) [Subtitle]: 咬開裡面還有湯汁感. (11) [Subtitle]: 如果不吃牛. (12) [Subtitle]: 豬肉餡餅也很多人點. (13) [Subtitle]: 肉餡的味道比較鮮甜. (14) [Subtitle]: 這裡的韭菜盒. (15) [Subtitle]: 包入不少韭菜跟冬粉. (16) [Subtitle]: 吃起來很清爽. (17) [Subtitle]: 帶點蝦米的香氣. (18) [Subtitle]: 還有現場桿製的蔥油餅. (19) [Subtitle]: 嚼起來厚實帶點Q感. (20) [Subtitle]: 越嚼越香. (21) [Subtitle]: 我們是直接點一張的份量. (22) [Subtitle]: 因為是現點現做. (23) [Subtitle]: 建議大家先打電話預訂. (24) [Subtitle]: 店家說會保留15分鐘. (25) [Subtitle]: 超過時間. (26) [Subtitle]: 就需要重新點餐喔. (27) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. [Slogan]: 無名餡餅蔥油餅韭菜盒 高雄市三民區壽昌路127號. (28) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice with a warm, conversational, and professional tone begins narrating over a bright, acoustic folk guitar track characterized by a steady mid-tempo strumming pattern. The background features a low-level urban environmental noise floor consistent with a busy street setting. A crisp, high-frequency sizzling sound is briefly audible, coinciding with the introduction of the food stall. (2) The acoustic guitar continues with a rhythmic major-key progression as the narrator describes specific beef and pork pies. There are faint incidental sounds of paper rustling and light percussive metal clicks from food handling tools. The vocal delivery is clear, with moderate pitch variability and a friendly valence. (3) The narration concludes with specific practical information including phone ordering tips and the stall's physical address. The spectral balance is natural and well-mastered, maintaining high clarity between the speech and the melodic guitar accompaniment until it softly fades out at the end.
